name: search_approved_exercises
description: Search approved exercises visible to the connector (read-only). Only approved exercises are returned. Supports limit (default 10, max 25) and an opaque cursor; responses include next_cursor when more results exist. When the query matches nothing, exercises is empty and search_link is the prefilled web app search URL (built from server config). Do not pass patient information.

query.description: Search text (exercise name or keywords). Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

body_region.description: Single body region label from the seeded list.

prescription_type.description: Optional filter: exercises that can be prescribed with this type.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response next_cursor. Omit on the first page.

summary.description: Plain text summary for the assistant. Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

share_link.description: HTTPS share link for the program when a published version exists or after publish. Empty string when no published link applies.

manage_url.description: HTTPS link to open the related screen in the web app. Empty when no screen applies.

body_regions.description: Body region labels from the seeded list.

items.description: How this exercise is prescribed on this program row. Stretch exercises use stretching only. Strengthening exercises use isometric, concentric, or eccentric.

allowed_prescription_types.description: Prescription types allowed for this exercise on a program row.

exercises.description: Matching approved exercises, empty when none match.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Omit when there are no more results.

search_link.description: Prefilled web app exercise search URL when the query returned zero approved exercises. Built from server-configured base URL.

name: search_routines
description: Search routines (read-only): cookie-cutter programs for common ailments. Includes community library entries and personal copies. Supports limit (default 10, max 25) and an opaque cursor. Do not pass patient information.

query.description: Search text (routine name or keywords). Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response next_cursor. Omit on the first page.

summary.description: Plain text summary for the assistant. Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

share_link.description: HTTPS share link for the program when a published version exists or after publish. Empty string when no published link applies.

manage_url.description: HTTPS link to open the related screen in the web app. Empty when no screen applies.

routine_name.description: Routine display name. Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

source.description: Whether this hit is the community routine or a personal copy.

routines.description: Matching routines, empty when none match.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Omit when there are no more results.

name: get_program_builder_link
description: Read-only deep link to the program builder in the web app. Pass program_code to open that program, from_routine_id to start a new program from that routine, or omit both for a new blank program. No rows are passed in the link. Publishing and share links use get_program_share_link_or_pdf. Do not pass patient information.

program_code.description: Stable program code assigned by the system (for example PRG-7K3Q).

from_routine_id.description: When creating a new program, open the builder seeded from this routine id.

summary.description: Plain text summary for the assistant. Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

share_link.description: HTTPS share link for the program when a published version exists or after publish. Empty string when no published link applies.

builder_link.description: Deep link to the program builder in the web app (built from server-configured base URL and shared route table).

manage_url.description: HTTPS link to open the related screen in the web app. Empty when no screen applies.

program_code.description: Stable program code assigned by the system (for example PRG-7K3Q).

from_routine_id.description: Routine id when the link starts a program from a routine.

name: get_program_share_link_or_pdf
description: Read-only program share link and PDF lookup. Provide program_code or program_title. Never publishes. When a published version exists, returns share_link, pdf_url, and expires_at. When only a draft exists, the summary states that and publish_link opens the publish page. When both draft and published exist, returns the live share_link and a publish_link for the draft. manage_link opens the share page for expiry, close link, and delete. Lookup by program_code or program_title; title works only when exactly one program matches, otherwise ambiguous_program_matches is returned. Do not pass patient information.

program_code.description: Stable program code assigned by the system (for example PRG-7K3Q).

program_title.description: Non-identifying program title the practitioner uses to recognise this program later. Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

summary.description: Plain text summary for the assistant. Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

share_link.description: HTTPS share link for the program when a published version exists or after publish. Empty string when no published link applies.

pdf_url.description: HTTPS URL of the server-rendered program PDF. Never inline bytes. Empty when no published PDF applies.

manage_url.description: HTTPS link to open the related screen in the web app. Empty when no screen applies.

publish_link.description: Deep link to the program publish page when a draft needs publishing. Empty when no draft publish page applies.

manage_link.description: Deep link to the program share page in the web app (expiry, close link, delete). Empty when no program applies.

expires_at.description: When the published share link expires. Omitted when there is no published link.

version.description: Monotonic program version number for this snapshot.

updated_at.description: When this version was last saved.

draft.description: Null when that side (draft or published) does not exist.

version.description: Monotonic program version number for this snapshot.

updated_at.description: When this version was last saved.

published.description: Null when that side (draft or published) does not exist.

program_code.description: Stable program code assigned by the system (for example PRG-7K3Q).

program_title.description: Non-identifying program title the practitioner uses to recognise this program later. Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

program_code.description: Stable program code assigned by the system (for example PRG-7K3Q).

program_title.description: Non-identifying program title the practitioner uses to recognise this program later. Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

updated_at.description: When this program was last updated.

ambiguous_program_matches.description: When program_title matches more than one program, list candidates and ask for program_code.
